head_commit.message:
Avoid cloning immutable metadata on tool search cache hits (#37279)

## Why

Checking the tool search cache currently rebuilds search metadata for every deferred tool, even when an immutable tool runtime has not changed.

## What changed

- Track immutable deferred tools by runtime identity and dynamic tools by their current search metadata.
- Rebuild the search handler when the deferred registry, dynamic metadata, or source-listing mode changes.
- Keep only weak references to immutable runtimes in the cache.

## Testing

Added unit coverage for immutable handler reuse, registry and exposure changes, source-listing changes, and refreshed dynamic tool metadata.

Avoid cloning immutable metadata on tool search cache hits (#37279)

## Why

Checking the tool search cache currently rebuilds search metadata for every deferred tool, even when an immutable tool runtime has not changed.

## What changed

- Track immutable deferred tools by runtime identity and dynamic tools by their current search metadata.
- Rebuild the search handler when the deferred registry, dynamic metadata, or source-listing mode changes.
- Keep only weak references to immutable runtimes in the cache.

## Testing

Added unit coverage for immutable handler reuse, registry and exposure changes, source-listing changes, and refreshed dynamic tool metadata.

head_commit.message:
## New Features
- Codex now supports the current MCP 2026 flow, including modern server discovery, paginated tool and resource catalogs, and multi-step tool or resource interactions. (#35724, #35725, #36001)
- Plugin discovery is broader: search can pull from the remote catalog, merge relevant local marketplace results, and install portable Agent Plugins that ship their own `plugin.json` and `mcp.json`. (#36409, #36919, #36544, #36796)
- MCP-backed tools can appear in the catalog before a server fully finishes starting, and unrelated optional MCP servers no longer hold up the rest of a turn. (#35590, #35742, #35937)
- The TUI now supports configurable two-key chords in `/keymap`, with conflict checks and inline hints for bindings such as `ctrl-x ctrl-s`. (#36511)
- Long TUI conversations resume faster by loading transcript history in pages and fetching older content as you scroll upward. (#36948, #36950)
- Interactive and `exec` sessions can now use `--approve-for-me` to send approval requests through automatic review. (#36373)

## Bug Fixes
- Follow-up prompts and slash commands no longer get stuck behind background MCP startup in the TUI. (#35957)
- Interrupting Windows non-TTY commands now reliably stops the underlying process instead of treating Ctrl-C as unsupported. (#35655)
- Codex now requires an explicit trust decision before enabling repo-local config, hooks, and exec policies for an untrusted local project. (#36960)
- Tool execution now consistently uses the selected turn environment’s permission profile, fixing mismatches across shell commands, `apply_patch`, image viewing, and spawned or resumed agents. (#36183, #37038)
- External-agent migration no longer treats symlink targets as safe to overwrite, preventing writes from escaping the repository. (#36051)

## Chores
- Refreshed the Rust MCP and remote code-mode transport stack to improve compatibility with newer servers, preserve clearer OAuth failures, and reduce control-channel stalls during large tool callbacks. (#36001, #36812)## Changelog

head_commit.message:
Avoid cloning immutable metadata on tool search cache hits (#37279)

## Why

Checking the tool search cache currently rebuilds search metadata for every deferred tool, even when an immutable tool runtime has not changed.

## What changed

- Track immutable deferred tools by runtime identity and dynamic tools by their current search metadata.
- Rebuild the search handler when the deferred registry, dynamic metadata, or source-listing mode changes.
- Keep only weak references to immutable runtimes in the cache.

## Testing

Added unit coverage for immutable handler reuse, registry and exposure changes, source-listing changes, and refreshed dynamic tool metadata.
